headline: Inspector、AppStats、近傍優先splatを、触れるGPU状態地図にする
headlineEn: Turn inspectors, AppStats, and nearest-first splats into a tactile GPU-state map
summary: PlayCanvas Engine v2.23.0の公式発表とrelease notes、Babylon.js 9.29.0、three.js r187 milestone / TSL examples、Codropsのcustom-shaped cursor trailと直近Creative Hubを確認した。10/2のview bind group / framegraph velocityから、今日はInspector / AppStats / TextureRenderer / streamed GSplat priorityと、frame graph reducer / velocity memory / cursor gridを2本の依存なしraw WebGL試作に展開した。
summaryEn: Reviewed the official PlayCanvas Engine v2.23.0 announcement and release notes, Babylon.js 9.29.0, the three.js r187 milestone and TSL examples, and Codrops' custom-shaped cursor trail plus recent Creative Hub entries. Extending 10/2's view-bind-group and framegraph-velocity work, today's two dependency-free raw WebGL prototypes explore Inspector/AppStats/TextureRenderer/streamed GSplat priority and frame-graph reducer/velocity memory/cursor-grid ideas.

sections.title: 今日の重要トピック
sections.body: 1. PlayCanvas Engine v2.23.0は10月1日に公開され、Inspector、TextureRenderer、AppStats、Device Loss and Recovery、Built-in Shader Uniforms、Profiling with AppStatsなどのマニュアルと新exampleが同時に出ている。実装変更ではWebGPUのpersistent storage buffer、view / material bind group、partial upload、pipeline reuse、nearest-first streamed GSplat LOD、stochastic alphaが中核。2. Babylon.js 9.29.0はframe graph min/max reducer、velocity outputのprevious world matrix追跡、CPU particlesのallocation削減、cached texture retry、WebGPU 3D texture mipmap修正がまとまった。3. three.jsはr187 milestoneが継続中で、TSL/WebGPUまわりの開発とWGSL/TSL interoperability、procedural terrain exampleが表現面の参考になる。4. Codropsはcustom-shaped cursor trailが、速度を書き込むgridとshader読解という構造を明示しており、今日の派生試作に直接つながる。
sections.bodyEn: 1. PlayCanvas Engine v2.23.0 landed on October 1 with new examples and manuals for Inspector, TextureRenderer, AppStats, Device Loss and Recovery, built-in shader uniforms, and profiling. Core implementation changes include WebGPU persistent storage buffers, view/material bind groups, partial uploads, pipeline reuse, nearest-first streamed GSplat LOD, and stochastic alpha. 2. Babylon.js 9.29.0 brings a frame-graph min/max reducer, previous world-matrix tracking for velocity outputs, fewer CPU-particle allocations, cached texture retries, and a WebGPU 3D texture mipmap fix. 3. three.js r187 remains active, and TSL/WebGPU work plus the WGSL/TSL interoperability and procedural terrain examples are useful expression references. 4. Codrops' custom-shaped cursor trail explicitly frames the interaction as a velocity grid read by a shader, which maps directly into today's derived prototype.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable examples and why they matter
sections.body: 今日の本命はPlayCanvas v2.23.0のInspector / TextureRenderer / AppStatsのまとまり。WebGPU最適化そのものより、hierarchy、frame graph、render targets、materials、shaders、GPU resourcesを走行中に見る発想が、このプロジェクトの「renderer state theater」に合う。nearest-first streamed GSplat LODは、カメラに近いものから届くという優先順位がそのまま演出になる。Babylon 9.29.0のmin/max reducerとvelocity修正は、値域と前フレームの記憶を同じ画面で扱える点が良い。Codropsのcursor trailは、gridに速度を刻む行為をbrushとして捉え直すことで、診断面を作品の筆跡へ変換できる。
sections.bodyEn: The strongest item today is the PlayCanvas v2.23.0 cluster around Inspector, TextureRenderer, and AppStats. Beyond WebGPU optimization itself, the idea of inspecting hierarchy, frame graph, render targets, materials, shaders, and GPU resources at runtime fits this project's renderer-state theater. Nearest-first streamed GSplat LOD is expressive because priority, meaning what arrives close to the camera first, becomes visible staging. Babylon 9.29.0's min/max reducer and velocity fixes let value range and previous-frame memory coexist. Codrops' cursor trail reframes writing speed into a grid as a brush, turning diagnostics into visible handwriting.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 短期: Inspectorで見えるGPU resource countを、バーや点群ではなく、カメラから近い順に点灯するsplat地図にする。dragでcamera priority、clickでstream burstを出す。派生: Babylonのmin/max reducerを譜面化し、cursor trailの速度記憶をその値域に押し込む。中長期: 9/29のresidency、10/1のviewport/scissor、10/2のbind group / framegraph、今日のAppStats / nearest-first streamを、1つのrender-state atlasに統合する。
sections.bodyEn: Short term: make Inspector-visible GPU resource counts into a splat map that lights up from nearest to the camera, not just bars or dots; drag controls camera priority and click emits a stream burst. Derived idea: turn Babylon's min/max reducer into a score and push cursor-trail velocity memory into that value range. Longer term: integrate 9/29 residency, 10/1 viewport/scissor, 10/2 bind groups/framegraphs, and today's AppStats/nearest-first stream into one render-state atlas.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: PlayCanvas側で実ログ化するなら `frameId/cameraPosition/splatNodeId/nodeDistance/loadPriority/lodLevel/loadedBytes/splatBudget/resourceBuffers/resourceTextures/resourceRenderTargets/resourcePipelines/bindGroups/gpuMemoryBytes` が良い。TextureRendererの発想を借りるなら、depth / color / velocity / id を小さなpreview tileにして、shader側ではtileごとの明滅や色温度に変換する。Babylon側は `frameGraphBlock/minValue/maxValue/previousWorldMatrixValid/velocityMagnitude/textureRetryCount/cacheHit/mipmapLevel/effectError`。Codrops型のcursor gridは `brushX/brushY/velocity/shapeId/inkDecay` を1枚の低解像度textureとして扱うと、音反応やWebXR controllerにも転用しやすい。
sections.bodyEn: For PlayCanvas logs, useful fields are `frameId/cameraPosition/splatNodeId/nodeDistance/loadPriority/lodLevel/loadedBytes/splatBudget/resourceBuffers/resourceTextures/resourceRenderTargets/resourcePipelines/bindGroups/gpuMemoryBytes`. Borrowing from TextureRenderer, depth/color/velocity/id can become small preview tiles that the shader converts to blinking or color temperature. For Babylon, collect `frameGraphBlock/minValue/maxValue/previousWorldMatrixValid/velocityMagnitude/textureRetryCount/cacheHit/mipmapLevel/effectError`. A Codrops-style cursor grid should store `brushX/brushY/velocity/shapeId/inkDecay` as one low-resolution texture so the same input can be reused for audio and WebXR controllers.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: PlayCanvas v2.23.x patch、特にInspector / AppStats / TextureRenderer / streamed GSplat LODまわりを継続監視する。Babylon 9.29.xはframe graph reducer、velocity output、WebGPU texture mipmap、cached retryの修正を追う。three.jsはr187の正式release、TSL tree-shaking、WGSL/TSL interoperability、subgroup / FFT / fallback関連PRを確認する。CodropsはTSL/WebGPUチュートリアルとCreative HubのWebGL事例を引き続き表現参照にする。
sections.bodyEn: Watch PlayCanvas v2.23.x patches, especially around Inspector, AppStats, TextureRenderer, and streamed GSplat LOD. For Babylon 9.29.x, track frame-graph reducers, velocity outputs, WebGPU texture mipmaps, and cached retries. For three.js, watch the formal r187 release, TSL tree-shaking, WGSL/TSL interoperability, subgroup/FFT/fallback PRs. Keep using Codrops TSL/WebGPU tutorials and Creative Hub WebGL demos as expression references.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: まず `outputs/2026-10-03_splat_resource_inspector_field.html` を開く。1でnearest-first splat queue、2でAppStats風resource bars、3でTextureRenderer風depth preview、4で合成。dragでcamera priority、click/Spaceでstream burstが出る。次に `outputs/2026-10-03_reducer_cursor_memory_score.html` を開き、min/max reducer、velocity memory、custom brush inkを切り替える。次に足すなら、PlayCanvas AppStats JSONを読み、resource barsとsplat queueを本物の値で動かす。
sections.bodyEn: Open `outputs/2026-10-03_splat_resource_inspector_field.html` first. Mode 1 shows a nearest-first splat queue, mode 2 AppStats-style resource bars, mode 3 TextureRenderer-style depth previews, and mode 4 the composite; drag controls camera priority and click/Space emits a stream burst. Then open `outputs/2026-10-03_reducer_cursor_memory_score.html` to switch between min/max reducer, velocity memory, and custom brush ink. Next, load PlayCanvas AppStats JSON and drive the resource bars and splat queue with real values.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: ネタ収集: PlayCanvas v2.23.0公式発表 / release notes、Babylon 9.29.0、three.js r187 / TSL examples、Codrops custom cursor trailを確認。アイデア検討: 10/2のbind group / framegraphを、Inspectorで見えるresource mapとcursor gridの筆跡へ拡張。サンプル実装: 本命 `outputs/2026-10-03_splat_resource_inspector_field.html` と派生 `outputs/2026-10-03_reducer_cursor_memory_score.html` を作成。結果の検証: JSON parse、HTML parse、script構文、gallery build、publish処理で確認する。継続案件はrender-state atlas、新規案件はAppStats driven splat map、寝かせる案件はカードUI系と重いWebGPU依存つき移植。
sections.bodyEn: Collection: reviewed the PlayCanvas v2.23.0 announcement/release notes, Babylon 9.29.0, three.js r187/TSL examples, and Codrops custom cursor trail. Ideation: extended 10/2 bind-group/framegraph work into Inspector-visible resource maps and cursor-grid handwriting. Implementation: created the main sample `outputs/2026-10-03_splat_resource_inspector_field.html` and derived sample `outputs/2026-10-03_reducer_cursor_memory_score.html`. Verification: JSON parsing, HTML parsing, script syntax, gallery build, and publish flow. Continuing item: render-state atlas. New item: AppStats-driven splat map. Parked item: card UI and heavy WebGPU dependency ports.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: この数日の流れは、GPUの結果画像よりも、描画途中の所有関係、優先順位、値域、履歴、回復を前景化する方向にまとまってきた。9/29のresidency、9/30のlayer/depth、10/1のviewport/scissor、10/2のbind group / framegraph、10/3のInspector / AppStatsは、全部「見える内部状態」を素材にする同じ流れ。育てる価値が高いテーマは、debug表示をそのまま見せるのではなく、観客の入力や音で内部状態の読み取り方が変わる舞台にすること。
sections.bodyEn: The recent direction is cohering around foregrounding ownership, priority, value ranges, history, and recovery during rendering, rather than only the final GPU image. 9/29 residency, 9/30 layer/depth, 10/1 viewport/scissor, 10/2 bind groups/framegraphs, and 10/3 Inspector/AppStats are all part of the same visible-internal-state theme. The worthwhile long-term direction is not to show debug data directly, but to stage it so viewer input or audio changes how those internal states are read.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 本命は `outputs/2026-10-03_splat_resource_inspector_field.html`。PlayCanvas v2.23.0のInspector、AppStats、TextureRenderer、nearest-first streamed GSplatから着想したraw WebGLのGPU状態地図。派生は `outputs/2026-10-03_reducer_cursor_memory_score.html`。Babylon 9.29.0のframe graph min/max reducerとvelocity output、Codrops cursor trailの速度gridを組み合わせた譜面。どちらも依存なしで、1-4キー、drag、click/Spaceで確認できる。
sections.bodyEn: The main prototype is `outputs/2026-10-03_splat_resource_inspector_field.html`, a raw WebGL GPU-state map inspired by PlayCanvas v2.23.0 Inspector, AppStats, TextureRenderer, and nearest-first streamed GSplats. The derived prototype is `outputs/2026-10-03_reducer_cursor_memory_score.html`, combining Babylon 9.29.0's frame-graph min/max reducer and velocity outputs with Codrops-style cursor velocity grids. Both are dependency-free and support 1-4 keys, drag, and click/Space.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ考察
sections.titleEn: Possibilities for the sample data and combinations
sections.body: 今回の2本は、入力を `cameraX/cameraY/brushX/brushY/pulse/mode`、描画状態を `splatNodeId/nodeDistance/loadPriority/resourceBuffers/resourceTextures/resourceRenderTargets/resourcePipelines/bindGroups/minValue/maxValue/velocityMagnitude/inkDecay/retryCount` として保存できる。音反応ではkickでstream burst、snareでretry spike、低域でsplat budgetを揺らす。WebXRでは左右eyeごとにpriority mapを分け、controller velocityをbrush gridへ書く。MediaPipeでは手の速度をnearest-first queueへ入れ、観客に近い関節から粒子が解像される演出にできる。
sections.bodyEn: These two samples can store inputs as `cameraX/cameraY/brushX/brushY/pulse/mode` and render state as `splatNodeId/nodeDistance/loadPriority/resourceBuffers/resourceTextures/resourceRenderTargets/resourcePipelines/bindGroups/minValue/maxValue/velocityMagnitude/inkDecay/retryCount`. For audio, kick can trigger stream bursts, snare can trigger retry spikes, and bass can modulate the splat budget. For WebXR, split the priority map per eye and write controller velocity into the brush grid. With MediaPipe, hand velocity can feed the nearest-first queue so joints nearer to the viewer resolve into particles first.
